title: Recap Session Context (CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AWAY_SUMMARY=1)
reason: Enables the /recap away-summary feature for users with telemetry disabled. Without this env var, the feature cannot be toggled via /config. Provides on-demand session context recap when returning to long-running sessions — directly useful for iterative-improve loops and overnight heartbeat sessions. Official Anthropic v2.1.108 feature.
manual_usage: The /recap slash command works regardless of env var — it only controls the automatic away-summary trigger
